none: PAS FindID 978237: Roman Coin, possibly a Dupondius of Vespasian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Possibly an dupondius of Vespasian (69-79), mint of Rome issue of 71. Obverse description: Bust probably radiate right, long neck and clean-shaven; the radiate crown was only discerned in a magnified view. Obverse inscription: IMP[---]ANVS[--]. Reverse description: female figure standing left holding cornucopiae and vertical object; small figure running left. S [C] in field. Reverse inscription [in exergue]: COS III. Diameter: 26.5mm, Weight: 10.76gms, die axis: 6
